skill.name: softsync-website-content
skill.description: Manage website content in a SoftSync workspace with guidance for reading pages, creating drafts, uploading media, and connecting a website.
skill.summary: Create and maintain draft website content using SoftSync workspace tables and documented CMS workflows.
skill.author: softsync-lab

content.value_statement: Website content becomes harder to maintain when page text and media are scattered across source files. This skill guides assistants through SoftSync workspace workflows for drafts, media, and website integration.
actual_capabilities: Guides workspace schema inspection before choosing content tables and fields.
Directs assistants to read existing records before creating drafts or applying requested updates.
Explains parent-record links and section ordering for pages and posts.
Documents media uploads, image descriptions, sizing, alignment, and supported video embeds.
Provides server-side API integration guidance, caching recommendations, and published-content filtering.
Explains live preview setup and checks that published content appears while drafts stay hidden from visitors.
limitations: Provides instructions, not a standalone CMS, API client, or website renderer.
Requires an accessible SoftSync workspace, appropriate credentials, and compatible tools or API access.
Leaves new content as drafts and does not publish on behalf of the team.
Supports the documented media syntax and video providers, not arbitrary HTML or script embeds.

use_cases.title: Prepare a blog draft
use_cases.description: Create a draft post with ordered sections, a clear summary, and notes for facts that still need confirmation.

use_cases.title: Connect a website to workspace content
use_cases.description: Plan server-side content loading, publication filters, media rendering, and cache settings using the workspace schema.

use_cases.title: Review a campaign page
use_cases.description: Read an existing page, propose targeted text changes, and prepare draft additions without replacing human writing before approval.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect available content
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect my SoftSync workspace schema and list the tables used for website posts and sections. Do not change any records.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: understand the existing content structure.

prompt_templates.title: Create a first draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a draft post about [topic] using these verified notes: [notes]. Add ordered sections and flag missing facts. Do not publish.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: prepare content for team review.

prompt_templates.title: Update a page with media
prompt_templates.prompt: Read [page] and propose changes for [goal], including image descriptions and video placement. Ask before replacing existing text and leave new content as drafts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: revise an existing page with approval.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate content and preview
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this website and workspace schema. Implement server-side content loading, published-only production views, documented media rendering, and restricted draft preview. Verify draft isolation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: connect a website with production and preview boundaries.

output_examples.input: Draft a product update using approved release notes without publishing it.
output: Summary: This update explains the changes listed in the approved release notes.
Sections: Overview, confirmed changes, and next steps.
Review note: Confirm any missing release date before publication.

output_examples.input: Review our website content integration before launch.
output: Production check: Visitors should see published rows only; unpublished pages should return 404.
Credential check: API requests should run on the server, with no API key in browser code.
Media check: Confirm image descriptions, supported video links, and safe Markdown rendering.
Preview check: Keep draft visibility restricted to development or authorized preview access.

best_practices: Inspect the workspace schema and read existing records before choosing fields or making changes.
Keep credentials server-side and verify that production pages never expose drafts.
Use verified facts, descriptive image text, and draft notes for unresolved information.
anti_patterns: Publishing drafts automatically or replacing human-written text without approval.
Putting the API key in browser code, project instructions, screenshots, or public repositories.
Rendering unchecked raw HTML or enabling draft visibility on the live site.

faq.question: Does this skill publish posts automatically?
faq.answer: No. It instructs assistants to leave new posts as drafts so the team can review and publish them.

faq.question: What setup does it require?
faq.answer: You need a SoftSync workspace and compatible workspace tools or API access. Website integration also requires server-side credential handling.

faq.question: Can it change existing page text?
faq.answer: Yes, through available workspace tools or API access. It requires reading first, limiting changes to the request, and asking before replacing human writing.

faq.question: Which media formats does it document?
faq.answer: It covers Markdown images, size and alignment options, YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, and uploaded MP4 or WebM video links.

faq.question: Where should the API key be stored?
faq.answer: Use the SOFTSYNC_API_KEY environment variable on the server. Never place the key in browser code, saved project instructions, or public repositories.

faq.question: Does it include a working website or renderer?
faq.answer: No. It provides integration instructions and expects an existing website renderer that supports the documented Markdown extensions.
